basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 527 at the acclaimed Madrone in Mission Bay, a luminous two-bedroom, two-bath home with a flowing open layout bathed in natural light. Floor-to-ceiling windows and glass doors open to a private balcony overlooking the lush and serene courtyard. The gourmet chef's kitchen, anchored by a Caesarstone island and stainless appliances, is ideal for refined entertaining. A serene primary suite boasts a walk-in closet and a spa-like bath, while the second bedroom offers flexibility for guests or a home office, with a full second bath nearby. Luxurious details include wide-plank oak floors, custom window treatments, and in-unit laundry, all enhancing the elegant, inviting interior. Additional storage unit and 1 car garage parking means you always have a space to come home. Residents enjoy a resort-style amenity collection: 24/7 concierge and security, 75-foot heated lap pool with spa & sauna, fitness center, private club lounge and screening room, business suite with meeting rooms, a BBQ terrace, and more. This home offers the ideal Mission Bay lifestyle, just steps from Chase Center and Oracle Park for premier sports and entertainment. Short stroll to waterfront parks, UCSF medical campus, upscale dining, boutique shops, with transit connections and freeways nearby.
